name: amper
description: Chemistry autocorrect and autocomplete for Google Docs

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/playground/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/google-docs-extension/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amper/playground && npm run build -w @amper/google-docs-extension
scripts.e2e:extension: npm run build:extension && playwright test -c playwright.extension.config.ts
